newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and
heifers were mostly $1.00 per cwt higher.
Week to date - 129,200 Last Week - 26,600 Year Ago - 51,600
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs
65.00, few early 64.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs
65.00, few early 64.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 43,500 slaughter steers and 35,200 heifers; 129,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 34,800 formulated, 200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week and 2,400 head or 59 loads CME cattle deliveries.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
